w1_material_fit.description: Compatibility of biomass physical and chemical characteristics with conversion technology
w1_material_fit.limitations: Does not account for proprietary pretreatment variations

w2_processing_fit.description: Operational tolerance to moisture and required processing steps (drying, chopping)
w2_processing_fit.limitations: Estimates energy penalty based on typical moisture curve

w3_logistics.description: Proximity to registered off-takers and aggregation hubs based on Haversine distance
w3_logistics.limitations: Straight-line distance; road transit distance and road quality will differ

w4_market_fit.description: Local off-taker demand readiness, commercial maturity, and off-take diversity
w4_market_fit.limitations: Prices and offtake willingness fluctuate seasonally

w5_ease.description: Implementation simplicity, low capex intensity, and low permitting complexity
w5_ease.limitations: Varies by individual land and regulatory approvals
